name: Shin Koihime † Eiyuutan 5 ~Otome Enran ☆ Sangokushi Engi [Gi]~
original_name: 真・恋姫†英雄譚5～乙女艶乱☆三国志演義［魏］～
source:
Sousou, the High King, had one problem.

Because of her perfection as king,
Everyone relied on Sousou and assumed that her rule would last forever.

If something were to happen to Sousou, who would take the helm of the country on her behalf?

Sousou then makes a decision.

[Translated from the [url=https://baseson.nexton-net.jp/eiyu5/]official website[/url]]
translation:
霸王曹操遇到了一个问题。

正因为她作为君主太过完美，
所有人都依赖曹操，认定她的统治将永远延续。

倘若曹操出了什么事，又该由谁代替她掌舵国家？

于是，曹操做出了一个决定。

[译自[url=https://baseson.nexton-net.jp/eiyu5/]官方网站[/url]]
